fills.researcher_notes: The brief's context note said this row already has two independent official documents disagreeing with GEM's length -- both located and reconciled this pass, per 'find them and resolve, don't re-derive'. Document 1: the Petroleum Division/PPIS 'Investment Brochure 2025' gas-transmission-network schematic map (ppisonline.com), labelling a segment '24"x81KM HQ2-TANDO ADAM SECTION' -- matches the sheet's existing 81 km exactly. Document 2: OGRA's 'State of the Regulated Industry' report, Table 3.21 ('SSGCL's Capacity Utilization of Transmission Network', source cited as SSGCL), listing a row '24'' Dia.X 84 Km HQ2-TandoAdam' with Available Capacity 85 MMCFD as of both 30 Jun 2019 and 30 Jun 2020 -- a 3 km / 3.7% disagreement with the PPIS map. TIEBREAKER found this pass: SSGC's own LIVE current network table (page_id=5597, 'Gas Transmission Capacities Utilization', re-fetched and read verbatim today) states '24\"dia. x84 Km HQ2-TandoAdam' -- Capacity 85 mmscfd. This is the pipeline's OWNER (SSGC) publishing the SAME 84 km figure as OGRA's regulatory filing, both independently of the PPIS map, and both from a more recent vintage (OGRA FY19/FY20; SSGC's page is presently live/current) than the map. 2 of 3 documents -- SSGC's own current asset register and OGRA's regulator table -- agree on 84 km against the PPIS map's 81 km (which is now the outlier). Capacity (85 MMcf/d) and Diameter (24 in) are an exact match across all three documents, so this is unambiguously the same line; only the length varies. Proposing 84.0 km, tier=medium not high: although two documents corroborate 84 km, OGRA's table is explicitly sourced '(Source: SSGCL)', i.e. the regulator is republishing SSGC's own reported figure rather than an independently-measured one, so this is really one origin (SSGC's asset register) confirmed twice over two vintages/publishers, not two independently-derived measurements. Either way (81 or 84 km), both are far longer than the drawn route's 59 km (ratio 0.72 against 81, 0.70 against 84), so the drawn ROUTE is the outlier regardless of which length is used -- see validity note.
